resource: ITEM_LOOK_INTENT commands (command type 30) of one GameSession
allocation_impact: A per-GameSession sliding window of at most 10 command instants in any 1 s, carried in session continuity across reconnect, resume and transfer. Admission precedes payload decoding; a malformed payload spends a slot. A refused admission changes no slot and performs no owner read. Over-rate commands return Accepted with Refused(RateLimited).
notes: CP D1143: 10 LOOK commands per sliding second per GameSession, including resume and transfer; LOOK-2 runtime handler.
